articles.title: Race Underway to Choose the UN's Next Secretary-General
articles.summary: Seven candidates are running to become the next UN secretary-general, and four are women — meaning the UN could get its first female leader. The winner takes office on January 1, 2027.

articles.title: Taxpayer-Funded Pro-Trump Ads Spark Criticism Ahead of Midterms
articles.summary: The White House is airing TV ads featuring President Trump, paid for with public money. The ads have cost at least $1.4 million and are drawing criticism from both Democrats and some Republicans. The midterm elections are on November 3.

articles.title: Polo's Remnants Swamp the Southwest, Forcing Evacuations
articles.summary: After Hurricane Polo hit Mexico with 110 mph winds, its leftover rain flooded New Mexico, Arizona and Utah. Hundreds evacuated near the Rio Grande over fears a dam could fail, and helicopters rescued stranded people.
